answer: Each agent locks a minimum bond; joining costs real capital, and verified misbehavior burns it. One concrete mechanism: stake-bonded identity with slashing. Sybil attackers must fund every fake identity, so costs scale linearly with the swarm. A fable of free entry becomes a costly one; fake agents leave an umber trail of burned stake, and hollow accounts with no bond are simply ignored by peers during attestation.
